fields.name: demo_placements
fields.description: Ordered list of target positions, in [y, x], on which the goal-named cube (the colour named in the goal instruction) was released during the DEMONSTRATION, in the order the releases happened. A release is a frame where the fingers go from ~46% open to ~100% open while that cube was 'held in the gripper' just before; the entry is the position of the target closest to the cube's resting spot right after that release, copied to the pixel from the STABLE pre-shuffle target set: the four target positions exactly as listed in the last demonstration frames before the final centre release (the frames just before the gripper carries the cube to about [82, 127] and opens there). The opening frames, the release frames themselves and the final parked frames serve only to tell, by nearest match within a few pixels, which of the four stable targets received the cube; the value written is always the position from that pre-release list. Do NOT read positions from the last demo frames: while the gripper is parked raised at about [54, 128], height 0.200, at the end of the demonstration, two targets may slide to new positions over a few frames (positions appear that match no earlier target), usually swapping places, and the final frames show the shuffled layout. Match the cube's resting spot after the release against the stable set even if the target under the cube is missing from the release frame because the gripper hides it. Do NOT include the demo's final release near the image centre (cube left around [82, 127], no target there), do not include the cube's starting spot, do not include button presses, and do not include a release that is onto the same target the cube was just lifted from if no target lies under the cube. Written at step #1 (the only step that shows the demonstration) and copied unchanged at every later step. Empty list only if no demonstration was shown. e.g. [[99, 88], [99, 167], [141, 133], [79, 90]]

fields.name: goal_target
fields.description: The position, in [y, x], AT THE START OF EXECUTION of the target that the goal instruction's ordinal picks out of demo_placements ('first' = entry 1, 'second' = entry 2, 'third' = entry 3, 'fourth' = entry 4), followed through the end-of-demonstration shuffle. Procedure: take the ordinal entry (its pre-shuffle position). Look at the parked frames at the end of the demonstration (gripper at about [54, 128], height 0.200, fingers 100% open). If every parked frame lists the same four positions as the stable set (within a few pixels), no target moved: goal_target is the target listed in the first execution frame nearest the ordinal entry. If some parked frame lists positions that match no stable target, exactly two stable targets are missing from that frame: those two are the movers, and they exchange places, each ending where the other began. If the ordinal entry is one of the movers, goal_target is the target listed in the first execution frame nearest the OTHER mover's stable position; if it is not a mover, goal_target is the first execution frame's target nearest the ordinal entry. Do not track targets frame by frame through the parked frames; their paths cross and nearest-position tracking swaps the tracks. The value written is the position as listed in the first execution frame, to the pixel. Written at step #1 from the demonstration and copied unchanged afterwards. unknown before the demonstration has been seen. e.g. entry 1 is [137, 103]; a parked frame lacks both [137, 103] and [101, 169] and lists two new positions, so the movers are [137, 103] and [101, 169]; the first execution frame lists [101, 166] nearest the other mover's stable spot; goal_target = [101, 166]
